scope: RARD I and RARD II logged recommendation benchmark variants.
method: Read source paper/Dataverse search metadata; inspect file search result and probe anonymous Range on filtered matrix file. No full payload downloaded.

probe.summary: Dataverse public search API returned HTTP 200. It lists the RARD dataset and the filtered matrix as unrestricted metadata, but the file metadata says canDownloadFile=false and the direct byte-range endpoint returned HTTP 403. This does not prove a user access gate; it means payload downloadability is unverified in this environment.

variants.supervised_target: clicked versus non-clicked recommendation, with important crawler/no-click-label noise; filtered matrix retains only sets where at least one item was clicked and contains 63,923 source documents.
variants.plain_mlp_fit: Pointwise click scoring is possible in principle from fixed numerical/categorical log fields, but item IDs span a 9.5M-document corpus. Dense one-hot item inputs violate the architecture/resource profile; article metadata are not included. The unfiltered log has 57,435,086 rows and is also far beyond full-batch capacity.
variants.license: CC BY 3.0 stated by the dataset paper and Dataverse search description.
variants.access_status: Dataverse public search API returned HTTP 200 and exposes a non-restricted file entry, but the anonymous range GET of filtered matrix file ID 3027416 returned HTTP 403 from this machine. Public metadata/search is not proof that the artifact bytes can be downloaded here; distinguish endpoint/network block from a real access gate.
variants.difficulty_pilot: Not run; source task fails full-batch scale and artifact bytes were not acquired.
variants.disposition: CROSS OUT for this repo profile: no full-batch-compatible all-pairs candidate representation, 9.5M item cardinality, and direct payload download not verified.

full_batch_activation_lower_bound.assumption: 80% of reported candidate rows in train; float32 [512]*5 hidden activations; excludes inputs, parameters, gradients, optimizer state and workspace.

filtered_rating_matrix.meaning: Dataverse search API exposes a public file entry, but download endpoint was forbidden from this environment; cannot distinguish provider restriction from network/anti-bot behavior.

variants.dataset: RARD II: The 2nd Related-Article Recommendation Dataset
variants.source_reported_clicked: Not established in sources inspected during this screen
variants.supervised_target: Logged related-article recommendation and click fields; dataset paper describes implicit item-item ratings.
variants.plain_mlp_fit: Pointwise MLP click scoring is structurally possible after a candidate-row transform, but 94M rows and 24M items make dense one-hot all-batch training infeasible. Metadata are not supplied in the recommendation log, and the native rating matrix is relational/sparse rather than a ready dense tabular input.
variants.license: CC BY 3.0 reported for RARD II by project publication; per-version Dataverse metadata not independently retrieved.
variants.access_status: The public Dataverse search API lists the dataset; exact file listing and anonymous payload access were not verified from this machine.
variants.difficulty_pilot: Not run; hard batch-size and feature-representation gates fail first.
variants.disposition: CROSS OUT for this suite profile due to full-batch scale/item cardinality and unverified direct payload access.

full_batch_activation_lower_bound.assumption: 80% of reported candidate rows in train; float32 [512]*5 hidden activations; excludes inputs, parameters, gradients, optimizer state and workspace.

limits: Dataset is crossed out on the large whole-batch dense-ID task even before artifact retrieval. Public search listing and CC BY 3.0 statement pass visibility/license checks, but actual downloadable payload is not established from this machine.
